## Checklist

- [ ] No vendor-specific language (Claude/ChatGPT/Copilot/etc.) outside `adapters/`
- [ ] No content duplicated from an existing skill/rule/checklist — linked instead
- [ ] File follows the format defined in `CONTRIBUTING.md` for its type
- [ ] Every code example is realistic (real error handling, cancellation tokens where
      relevant, no placeholder names)
- [ ] `templates/projects/*` changes: solution builds and tests pass locally
- [ ] Linked to relevant existing content instead of restating it
